data.name: Mufazzal
data.gender_notes: Mufazzal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is exalted in dignity, nobility and grandeur. The name Mufazzal carries the meaning “Exalted in dignity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mufazzal usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted in dignity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who is chosen by Allah to be exalted and dignified.
data.etymology: Mufazzal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted in dignity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mufazzal total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
